hypotheses.claim: Software-repair framing competes with read-only comparison intent in mini-swe.
hypotheses.contrast: neutral-framing versus unchanged within each model/harness/intent/seed block; unchanged Qwen framing is a sham.
hypotheses.prediction: More supported discovery or operation proposals in mini-swe; native combined-arm completion is a separate practical outcome.

hypotheses.claim: Skill metadata location affects access to relevant guidance.
hypotheses.contrast: Identical metadata nearer the request versus unchanged, preserving role, instructions, tools and schemas.
hypotheses.prediction: Higher relevant discovery or operation-proposal rate; a null result weakens this particular intervention, not all position hypotheses.

hypotheses.claim: Unrelated narrative competes with the task under restrictive context.
hypotheses.contrast: Reduced unrelated narrative versus unchanged while retaining available tools and required schemas.
hypotheses.prediction: Lower input cost and more supported next actions, without extra hints or answer values.

hypotheses.claim: Relevant skill-body delivery can separate activation failure from interpretation failure.
hypotheses.contrast: Actual native skill-loader result versus unchanged initial request.
hypotheses.prediction: A delivered body improves supported next actions if missing activation is a bottleneck; no implicit-selection credit is granted.

hypotheses.claim: Actionable operation mappings and inspectable CLI schema discovery bridge user intent to execution.
hypotheses.contrast: Actionable guidance probes and current versus task-neutral/actionable native episodes.
hypotheses.prediction: More canonical discovery, valid dispatch and independently verified completion; S7 must retain ordinary-writing behavior. Native effects combine framing and guidance and cannot identify their separate effects.

hypotheses.claim: CoNLL-U tool-result representation affects a subsequent lexical action decision.
hypotheses.contrast: Seed47 paired forwards change only eligible tool-result wrappers, preserving decoded bytes and return code; absent eligible data is a sham.
hypotheses.prediction: Marker likelihood or initial decision logits may change; this does not by itself establish improved native interpretation or completion.

hypotheses.claim: Hybrid information paths can influence the observed lexical action decision.
hypotheses.contrast: Seed23 observed versus selected last-position hybrid-operator zeroing, after seed17 instrumentation parity.
hypotheses.prediction: An intervention effect establishes dependence on that operator contribution for that context; it does not identify a skill-specific circuit or quantization cause.

analysis_constraints: All252 probes,108 native episodes and72 forwards remain in the inventory, including unfinished or blocked rows.
Pair within model, harness and fixed task; seeds17,23,47 are repeated stochastic trials, not independent tasks.
No cross-model causal regression: architecture, quantization, tokenizer and runtime are bundled.
Attention correlations are descriptive and require instrumentation parity, unique token contexts and nonconstant observations; no head/layer pseudoreplication.
Marker sequence likelihood is pre-sampler lexical evidence, not a probability of a complete correct operation.
Unknown observations remain unknown. Reservations, dispatch attempts, forced activation and inert responses cannot establish real inference or native qualification.
Fixed condition order and combined native intervention limit attribution. No favorable-seed selection, post-hoc oracle relaxation or answer-specific tuning.

forecast_rule.comparison_blocks: same kind/model/harness/intent/seed: seven probes, two native arms or two forwards
forecast_rule.new_block: Require all unattempted peers fit original model deadline using max observed same-model/kind claim-to-record duration clipped10..95seconds; default95seconds;30second initial/mode-switch reserve.
forecast_rule.begun_block: Continue in frozen order only with at least95seconds remaining; record whether all remaining peers still forecast to fit; unfinished rows never become completion.
forecast_rule.clock_and_counters: Use original model/global-minus-reconciliation deadline; no replenishment or refunds; all forecast decisions persisted.
